recipe.title: 🟢 Vehicle Status — GO
recipe.body:
Depth rating 6,000 m
Battery 87%  •  O₂ 94%
Thrusters 6/6  •  Comms nominal
Crew: 2  •  Surface link locked

recipe.title: Mission Objective
recipe.body:
Survey the Black Smoker field
Collect 3 vent-fluid samples
Return with ≥30% battery reserve

recipe.title: 🔴 Abort Criteria
recipe.body:
ABORT if any trigger occurs:
• Hull alarm or active leak
• O₂ <70% or battery <35%
• Comms lost >90 seconds
• Two thrusters offline

recipe.title: 01  DESCEND
recipe.body:
T+00–45 min  •  0 → 3,200 m
Hold 0.8 m/s; sonar sweep every 500 m
Gate: pressure + comms check

recipe.title: 02  SURVEY + SAMPLE
recipe.body:
T+45–105 min  •  Vent field
Map north transect; collect A/B/C
Gate: depart at 45% battery

recipe.title: 03  ASCEND
recipe.body:
T+105–155 min  •  Surface
Clear plume; rise at 0.9 m/s
Gate: beacon on at 200 m

recipe.title: ⚠ Major Risks
recipe.body:
HIGH  Plume turbulence — stay leeward
MED   Tether snag — keep 15 m clearance
MED   Acoustic dropout — 90 s abort clock
LOW   Sample arm jam — skip slot, continue

recipe.title: Command Rule
recipe.body:
Safety gate beats mission goal.
At every phase boundary: confirm hull, power, oxygen, propulsion, and comms before proceeding.
